sec.title: Binance Investigates Suspicious Crypto Transfers Worth Up to $5.8 Billion
sec.brief: S. gov Domains Ads or Surveillance? S. S. CISA adds PHP flaws PHP2Shell to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Binance is investigating a potential security incident after billions of dollars in cryptocurrency moved from wallets linked to the exchange on October 29. The transfers raised concerns about a possible hack, while Tether and Circle moved to freeze stablecoins linked to the suspicious activity. The full scope of the incident remains unclear, and the reported outflows shouldn’t automatically be treated as confirmed losses. 55 billion in incoming transfers to an initially unidentified wallet.
